newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has challenged a major opposition party to name a "single person" arrested without specific criminal charges" and that he will be freed.
BNP Chairperson Begum Khaleda Zia was operated upon successfully at King Faisal Hospital in Riyadh yesterday.
West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu has proposed opening of road communication between Dhaka and Calcutta to facilitate more trade and cultural exchanges between Bangladesh and India.
BNP secretary-general Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan MP has said nobody can claim the sole credit for the liberation war and the independence of the country.

West Bengal Chief Minister Jyoti Basu on Sunday night reiterated his optimism about a fair solution to the peoblem of sharing the Ganges river. "I hope New Delhi would accept my suggestions," he said at a dinner hosted by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
Sheikh Hasina has called upon the people to extend their all-out cooperation and put in their best efforts to build a society free from poverty and hunger.

The Bangladesh Bank, the sole agency in formulating credit policy, has decided to withdraw its earlier restriction on term lending by the scheduled banks, especially by the nationalised comercial banks (NCBs).
